args.body: Dear Landlord, thank you for your email. First, a correction: our email of 17 Feb said no issues were found. That was wrong. The inspection report (attached to that email) records a dog flap fitted in the back door/utility room, and sticker marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. I'm sorry for the confusion. Dog flap: we have no record of your consent, and alterations need it under the tenancy. We are asking the tenant who fitted it, when, and whether consent was given. Please tell us if you did agree to it. Front door key: our records do not show a lock change. We are asking the tenant who changed it and when, and asking for a spare key to be given to the agency by Friday 23 Feb. Please tell us if you or anyone for you changed the lock. We will update you once the tenant replies, by 23 Feb.

args.body: Hi, thanks for having us in for the inspection. Two things please. 1) The inspection noted a dog flap in the back door. Alterations need the landlord's written consent under your tenancy agreement. Did you fit it, when, and was consent given? If so, please send us a copy. 2) Our records don't show a change of front door lock. Has the lock been changed, by whom and when? If so, please get a spare key to our office by Friday 23 Feb, so we have access in an emergency (we will always give 24 hours' written notice for normal visits). Also, please remove the sticker marks by the Bedroom 1 window and make good. Please reply by Friday 23 Feb. We'll be in touch again by then.
